messages:
alex: deploy-bot started canary shift for release v2.3.1 -> rolling 3% EU traffic now. change window: 03:00-04:00 UTC. release notes https://redwood.dev/releases/v2.3.1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: [canary] v2.3.1 -> targets: eu-west-1, eu-central-1; percent=3; owners=@alex @maria; next-step @ops: auto-increment to 10% in 20m if signals ok.
maria: seeing the deploy-bot ping — pulling metrics now. can we hold if embedding MRR drops?
jordan: heads up, synthetic embedding eval on the new model shows avg cosine down ~0.015 vs baseline on the prod promptset. small but noticeable. attaching quick diff in thread. :eyes:
sre-oncall: alert from prometheus: eu-tail latency p95 jumped +120ms around 4776654420, error 5xxs up from 0.3% -> 1.1% for inference workers in eu-west-1. correlating with canary start.
alex: thanks — let's pause the auto-increment. @deploy-bot cancel scheduled bump. we'll keep at 3% while we triage. :warning:
deploy-bot: acknowledged. scheduled increment cancelled. canary percent remains at 3%.
maria: running the human eval suite now (100 prompts). ETA ~12m. will post summary.
jordan: i'm pulling model logs and kv-cache stats. preliminary: a small mem churn pattern on a subset of pods — might be unrelated but investigating.
eva: if we decide to roll back EU quickly, i can pin routing for eu-* to v2.2.9 and cut traffic in ~6m. want me ready to submit that PR?
alex: yes please prep rollback PR but don't merge yet. label it "eu-pin-rollback-v2.2.9" and set reviewers to @eva @sre-oncall. if we can't find quick fix in 30m we pin.
sre-oncall: creating a short runbook entry: 1) hold at 3% 2) gather client logs + kv cache dump 3) run eval 4) decide rollback by +30m from now. posting runbook link in a sec.
maria: eval results: embedding recall drop on short queries: 0.8 -> 0.72, median diff -0.06. quality regression confirmed on our promptset.
jordan: correlating trace IDs with latency spikes, one model shard shows more GC cycles. suspect a kernel-level scheduling hiccup on that node group. raising infra ticket and isolating affected hosts to a drain group.
eal: (bot message) infra-ticket #INF-3123 created by jordan.
alex: ok consensus: we hold. @eva prepare the pin PR, and @jordan keep isolating hosts. we'll reconvene T+20m for quick decision. if the pin is ready earlier, post the PR link here. :thumbsup:
eva: PR ready draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/4123 — marked DO NOT MERGE. includes traffic pin to v2.2.9 for eu-*.
jordan: infra report: draining 3 hosts, replaced with warm ones, p95 latency improved on test cluster by ~40ms. more monitoring needed.
sre-oncall: metric snapshot (attached): p95 eu-west now trending toward baseline but still elevated +30ms. error rate down to 0.6%.
maria: QA note: quality gap persists on a subset of short completion prompts; could be sampling-related. i'm running deterministic eval to rule out stochastic differences. ETA 8m.
alex: current plan: keep at 3% for now. if deterministic eval shows same gap -> we pin. otherwise we continue triage and re-evaluate at +20m. decision deadline 4776654833.
eva: ack — standing by.
deploy-bot: canary heartbeat: percent=3, health=DEGRADED, last_check=4776654520. automated bump disabled.
jordan: logging shows one outlier commit in the model build pipeline that toggles rounding mode for quant kernels — investigating if that explains embedding drift.
maria: deterministic eval complete: same quality drop persists. looks like model variant difference, not sampling.
alex: decision: proceed with EU pin to v2.2.9. @eva merge when ready, then route change will be automated. merge window open now.
eva: merged PR and triggered routing change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/4123 (merged). routing job started.
deploy-bot: routing update: eu-* pinned to v2.2.9. percent for v2.3.1 in EU reduced to 0%. global canary remains unaffected.
sre-oncall: post-action metrics: p95 eu-west back to baseline, error rate stable at 0.35%. closing infra ticket as resolved with rollback.
alex: good catch team. follow-ups: 1) jordan to root-cause kernel/quant difference 2) maria to add the failing promptset to regression suite 3) add gating to canary auto-bump to block on embedding-quality eval. will capture in the postmortem.
maria: adding promptset now.
jordan: filing deeper RCA ticket and will sync with model-build team.
eva: noting change window impact and updating release notes with rollback details.
alex: thanks all. closing thread for now. we'll re-run canary once fixes and added eval gating are in place. :white_check_mark:
